metric_policy.complete_package_note: Complete package includes generated MBIST wrappers, algorithms, saboteur/model RTL, and staged SRAM behavioral models.

registers.name: CONTROL0
registers.description: Control register byte 0. Bitfields provide enable, clear_fault, and a software-visible request handshake qualifier if firmware is integrated to drive top-level control sequencing.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Software-visible enable control. When 0, nominal request/response processing is blocked and safe fallback behavior is expected.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULT
fields.description: Write 1 to request fault latch clear. Self-clears on the next control update if the integration policy permits.

fields.name: REQ_ACCEPT_HINT
fields.description: Optional software hint for request acceptance qualification; does not override RTL safety checks or top-level handshake signals.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Indicates deterministic safe fallback is active.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_COMMAND_VALID
fields.description: Indicates actuator_command is valid for the current control cycle.

registers.name: FSM_STATE
registers.description: Current FSM state encoding. Encodes the registered safety controller state.
